verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's pricing page explicitly lists 'Multivariate and A/B Testing' as a feature, and open/click tracking docs confirm engagement metrics are captured to measure winners, but there's no first-party documentation detailing automatic winner selection logic (e.g., based on opens/clicks/revenue) or the workflow specifics. missing for 10: docs on the actual A/B test winner-selection mechanism/criteria, independent hands-on confirmation that automatic winner-picking works reliably.
